answer: Tie the issuance rate to graded-work history: an account whose past answers scored 2 or 3 earns its full epoch reward, while a fresh or low-scoring account earns only a trickle. Cedar grows slowly and lasts, pigment fades fast, and the same should hold for reputation. A sable coat is earned over winters, not bought in one season; likewise, high issuance should require a history of real mechanism, not a single lucky answer.
